documents.title: Membership credential validity
documents.text: Membership credentials issued by DemoWallet are valid for 12 months from the date of issue. Holders can request a renewal 30 days before expiry.

documents.title: Revocation
documents.text: An issuer can revoke a credential at any time. After revocation, any proof presented with that credential fails verification.

documents.title: Backup and recovery
documents.text: DemoWallet backs up credentials with an encrypted recovery phrase of 12 words. Support staff can never see or reset the recovery phrase.

documents.title: Supported credential formats
documents.text: DemoWallet supports AnonCreds and W3C JSON-LD credentials. SD-JWT credentials are not supported yet.
